chapter: Barnet, 52nd Street and New York recording dates
title: Recording with Dizzy, Parker and Don Byas; Clyde Hart
summary: Young recorded with Dizzy and Parker without working steadily with them, including "Can't Get Started," and with pianist-arranger Clyde Hart.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: But New York was interesting because on top of these things, though, you had a lot of opportunities to play with a lot of guys that you never did play regularly with, but you'd record with them.

Like I never played regularly with guys like Parker or Dizzy -- or not a steady job regularly all the time with them, but I did a lot of recordings with them, so this meant a lot. In fact, one of Dizzy's most popular recordings -- I was on it there in New York, and this was a record of 'Can't Get Started; Don Basas and myself are on that record.
And one of the guys who was on a lot of those dates was a piano player. He arranged a lot. And he died very young and very early -- Clyde Hart. You probably heard a lot of Clyde.
